I have orders df with 120,000 rows approx, customers df with 9000 rows. I am trying to merge customer info into orders using customer_id. orders has 8 cols and customers 5. After doing left merge, I get 127845 rows, but I want 120000 because each order should have at max 1 customer. Some orders repeat. If I do merged[merged["order_id"] == 12345], I get two rows of same order, same customer, Alice Smith.
So I checked unique customer_ids. On orders df, nunique on customer_id returns 9000. Customers df returns 8750. Both dfs have customer_id, data types are ok, both int64. So the customer_id in orders must have duplicates. This is causing the duplicate rows on the merge. How do I figure out what is causing the extra rows and make sure each order is only associated with 1 customer?
